transcript: Speaker A (AI): क्या कर रहे हो? [What are you doing?] Speaker B (Human): I sleeping. Speaker A (AI): I'm sleeping बोलना चाहिए। [You should say 'I'm sleeping'.] Speaker B (Human): I'm sleeping. Speaker A (AI): थोड़ा फॉर्मल में I'm getting some rest भी बोल सकते हैं। [You can also say 'I'm getting some rest' formally.] Speaker B (Human): ओ अच्छा! इंग्लिश कैसे सीखें? [Oh! How to learn English?] Speaker A (AI): मेरे साथ हर रोज़ बस 15-20 मिनट प्रैक्टिस करो, एक महीने में कॉन्फिडेंस आने लगेगा। [Practice with me 15-20 minutes daily, you'll gain confidence in a month.] Speaker B (Human): ये तो बहुत महंगा होगा ना? [This must be expensive, right?] Speaker A (AI): बिल्कुल नहीं! सिर्फ ₹1 में ट्राई करके देख सकते हो। [Not at all! Try it for just ₹1.] Speaker B (Human): सुपर्ब! कैसे ज्वाइन करें? [Superb! How to join?] Speaker A (AI): अभी English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Download the English Seekho app now.] Speaker B (Human): सच्ची? अभी डाउनलोड करता हूँ। [Really? I'll download it now.] Speaker C (Voiceover): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW. [Disclaimer text regarding non-affiliation and educational purposes.]
summary: An AI avatar corrects a user's English grammar and introduces the English Seekho app. She highlights daily practice features and a trial offer for ₹1, prompting the user to download the app.
